points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` ... The flavour is a namespaced string, `'affine:paragraph'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
`props(internal)` returns the default props. `internal.Text()` creates a collaborative text field.
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
`toModel` returns an instance of a class that extends `BlockModel<Props>`, here `ParagraphBlockModel`.

`ParagraphBlockComponent extends CaptionedBlockComponent<ParagraphBlockModel>`. `CaptionedBlockComponent` is built on the std `BlockComponent` base. ... `BlockViewExtension('affine:paragraph', literal`affine-paragraph`)`.
Optional extras are services, widgets and toolbar entries.

`ParagraphStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider` ... This is the data side. `ParagraphViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider` ... It builds the editor's view from the view extensions through `ViewExtensionManager`.
The view's `effect()` runs once so the custom element gets defined.
